description: This file defines functions and types related to determining and resolving send policies for sessions, including normalization, key parsing, and policy rule evaluation.

methods.name: normalizeSendPolicy
methods.description: Normalizes a raw string input to a send policy decision ('allow' or 'deny').

methods.name: resolveSendPolicy
methods.description: Determines the effective send policy for a session based on configuration, session entry, session key, channel, and chat type.
